page.overview:
Who is John Arnold?

John Raymond "Ray" Arnold was the chief engineer of Jurassic Park in both the novel and the 1993 movie of the same name. He appears in the novels, movies and games. He was killed by a Velociraptor in both the film and novel.

Ray Arnold, full name possibly John Raymond Allen Arnold, is the chief engineer of Jurassic Park. His catchphrase was "Hold on to your butts," which he repeated twice in the film. Arnold was usually shown smoking a cigarette. In the first edition of the script, Hammond was greatly concerned for Arnold's health due to his constant smoking. He made frequent announcements over the loudspeaker informing the other employees of the position of the approaching storm. When the storms gets closer to the island, Arnold orders all remaining employees to evacuate the island while he stays behind with Hammond, Muldoon and Dennis Nedry. After Dennis turned the electricity off, he told John Hammond that he couldn't get Jurassic Park back online without Dennis. Arnold showed great irritation with Nedry's personal touches to the park's system.

Sometime Sunday morning, Hammond told Arnold to shut down the entire system and resets it. Arnold was against this idea because they had never shut down the entire system before and he was not sure that it would come back on at all. Despite this, Hammond was adamant and Arnold eventually shut down the system. He was greatly relieved, along with the rest of the survivors in the control room when the computers came back on. He set off on his own to the maintenance shed to reset Jurassic Park while the rest of the survivors went to the security bunker to await his return.

After a few minutes went by with still no sign of Arnold, Ellie Sattler realized something must have gone wrong and set out to reset Jurassic Park with the help of gamekeeper Robert Muldoon. However, the two found themselves stalked by the Velociraptor pack, and Muldoon told Ellie to head to the maintenance shed by herself while he deals with the raptors.
